brand_identity.name: Tendinha do Saber
brand_identity.description: Professional Portuguese school bookstore e-commerce platform (V2.0) specializing in school manuals and workbooks. Based in Aveiro.
brand_identity.vibe: Trustworthy, Professional, Warm, Scholarly, Established but with a regional touch.
forbidden_elements: Childish or overly playful UI elements

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' & 'Editorial' mix. Clean and highly readable.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium

typography.installation_instructions: Add Outfit, IBM Plex Sans, and Cormorant Garamond from Google Fonts via layout.js/html.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Bento Grids for catalog discovery, Control Room Grid for Admin.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12
layout_and_spacing.admin_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
layout_and_spacing.padding_scale: Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for generous breathing room. Cards with borders must use internal padding like p-6.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content. Ensure optical alignment.

storefront_cards.style: Neumorphic/Tactile hybrid: Flat background matching parent or crisp white, 1px subtle border, soft ambient shadow on hover (shadow-sm to shadow-md), rounded-sm or rounded-md (max 8px radius).

header.style: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FCFBF8]/80 with 1px delicate bottom border. Must ensure text is strictly legible (APCA contrast). Sticky to top with z-50.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1B4965] text-white rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#0F324A] transition-colors duration-200 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1B4965] text-[#1B4965] rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#1B4965] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-200

admin_components.strategy: Shadcn/UI components heavily utilized. Dense, compact styling. Tables, Badges, Tabs, and Dialogs. Cardless or minimal 1px border cards.

key_features_implementation.cascading_school_selector: Hero section bento box. 3 dropdowns (Shadcn Select). State managed sequentially: Ano -> Concelho -> Escola.
key_features_implementation.product_catalog: CSS Grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Image container with max-h-[300px] object-contain. Badges for stock absolute positioned over image top-right.
key_features_implementation.product_detail_page: Scrollytelling elements. 2-column layout (Image sticky left, details scroll right). Lamination service prominently displayed as a Shadcn Checkbox + Label (+2€).
key_features_implementation.cart_and_checkout: Checkout features geofencing toggle: Hand Delivery vs Store Pickup. Promo code input with instant server-side validation feedback. Voucher PDF upload using standard input type='file' stylized.
key_features_implementation.admin_excel_import: Drag and drop zone component for parsing book inventory. Clear success/error toast notifications via Sonner.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly change state (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
motion_and_interactions.catalog_load: Staggered entrance animations for book cards in grid.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='lamination-checkbox', data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').

images.description: Aveiro canal buildings. Use as a subtle faded background or hero abstract overlay.
Shallow focus stack of books. Ideal for category headers or banner.
Student studying in library. Use for 'About Us' or community section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure strict usage of `data-testid` across all interactive elements for both storefront and admin interfaces.
Do not use generic Inter font. Apply Outfit for Headings, IBM Plex Sans for UI/Body, and Cormorant Garamond for literary/book title accents.
Maintain high APCA contrast ratios, especially for the #1B4965 primary brand color against light backgrounds.
Implement the storefront using custom semantic HTML with Tailwind for layouts (avoid rigid Shadcn cards for the marketing/catalog parts), but use Shadcn primitives for forms, selects, and dialogs.
Implement the admin panel entirely using Shadcn/UI for a dense, data-heavy layout (Soft Utility archetype).
In checkout, strictly implement logic for Aveiro geofencing (Hand Delivery) vs Store pickup, and the 2€ lamination service.
Use standard Lucide icons, sized properly, avoiding visual clutter.
